description: Blocks edits that weaken the pnpm supply-chain posture (PreToolUse on edit tools) and Bash commands that flip the same switches out-of-band (PreToolUse on Bash). Both hooks run on Deno; the file guard reads, the command guard touches nothing but stdin.

hooks.command: command -v deno >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'pnpm-guard: deno not found on PATH - install Deno (https://deno.land) so the file guard can run' >&2; exit 1; }; exec deno run --quiet --config "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/deno.jsonc" --allow-read "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/src/file-guard.ts"

command -v deno >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'pnpm-guard: deno not found on PATH - install Deno (https://deno.land) so the command guard can run' >&2; exit 1; }; exec deno run --quiet --config "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/deno.jsonc" --allow-read "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/src/command-guard.ts"
